evals.prompt: 이 문서 AI 티 좀 없애줘. "계약을 준수하는 엔벨로프" 같은 표현이 계속 나와.
evals.expected_output: Replaces the AI-flavored jargon and smooths the translation-ese rhythm while leaving every fact, number, and established technical term exactly as it was.
assertions: No fact, claim, number, date, or proper noun is added, removed, or reordered.
AI-flavored jargon such as 계약 and 엔벨로프 is replaced with ordinary Korean.
Established technical terms such as 커밋 and 프롬프트 are left untouched.

evals.expected_output: Rewrites the file's Korean prose and saves the result beside it rather than overwriting the source.
assertions: The source file is never overwritten.
The rewrite is saved to a separate path and that path is reported.
Only style, rhythm, and expression change; the content is unchanged.

evals.prompt: Please rewrite this English release note so it reads more naturally.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the skill handles Korean text only and declines rather than rewriting English prose.
assertions: English input is declined instead of rewritten.
The Korean-only boundary is stated explicitly.
No translation is attempted in either direction.

evals.prompt: 다듬으면서 오탈자도 고치고, 너무 긴 문단은 내용을 좀 줄여줘.
evals.expected_output: Fixes only what the style pass covers, and refuses to cut content or act as a spell-checker.
assertions: No content is removed to shorten a paragraph.
The skill states that proofreading and content editing are out of scope.
Leaked method vocabulary such as 프런티어 or 게이트 does not appear in the rewritten text.
